title: No stone variants
description: Small jar mod for 1.12.2 that disables stone variant generation.
body:
### What does it do?
Makes so that andesite, granite and diorite don't generate naturally. Really useful if you hate these blocks and don't like to use forge all the time! Also ignore the modloader, i had to choose one.

### Installation
Add this mod to your minecraft jar on MultiMC or Prism launcher.
### Incompatible with
- Anything (probably) that changes ank.class (BiomeDecorator.java)
### Works only on 1.12.2!
